newsitem.title: USA: BankAmerica seeking securities firm - analyst.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica seeking securities firm - analyst.

text.p: BankAmerica Corp is interested in acquiring an investment banking firm, according to Ray Soifer, analyst with Brown Brothers Harriman.

"From everything we saw and heard during our visit, we believe that BankAmerica is seriously interested in acquiring all or part of a substantial investment banking firm, perhaps as soon as early 1997," said Soifer.
BankAmerica said that as a matter of policy, it would not discuss speculation concerning acquisitions.
"From my conversations, I think they're looking for a firm with a strong interest in technology," Soifer said.
Soifer said that BankAmerica was more serious about a potential acquisition following the Federal Reserve's recent relaxation of rules governing bank securities subsidiaries.
On December 20, the Fed raised the percentage of revenue banks can derive from securities underwriting from 10 percent to 25 percent.
